title: Tamsin Systems: m and a review (fictional)

documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Tamsin Systems (fictional).
In this document "TSH" means Tamsin Systems. Tamsin Systems reports headcount of 1640 for FY2024 under the original agreement. Tamsin Logistics subsidiary reports normalised net working capital of $87.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. TSH reports earn out of $29m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin Systems reports enterprise value of $1083.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Tamsin Systems, the form of consideration is: all-cash consideration. The fiscal year of Tamsin Systems ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Financial due diligence report
documents.text:
Financial due diligence report — Tamsin Systems (fictional).
Tamsin Systems reports headcount of 2034 for FY2024 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Tamsin Systems reports normalised net working capital of $74.2m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Systems reports gross margin of 59.4% for FY2024. Tamsin Systems reports EBITDA of $83.3m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. For Tamsin Systems, the form of consideration is: part-share consideration with a 12-month lock-up.

documents.title: Draft share purchase agreement
documents.text:
Draft share purchase agreement — Tamsin Systems (fictional).
Tamsin Systems reports earn out of $23m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin Systems reports headline valuation of $922.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Systems reports gross margin of 48.2% for FY2024. Tamsin Systems reports EBITDA of $72.9m for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025) on a reported basis. "headline valuation" has the same meaning as "enterprise value".
